listing_title: Appartamento Trilocale con Terrazzo Abitabile — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / APPARTAMENTO TRILOCALE CON TERRAZZO ABITABILE FOR SALE · APARTMENT Appartamento Trilocale con Terrazzo Abitabile JESOLO PAESE · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €295,000 Photos (33) Floor plans (1) 1 / 33 FLOOR AREA 90 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Paese! Imagine coming home after a long day at work and finding the silence, greenery, and tranquility of an elegant residence, knowing that the sea is just a few minutes away. Only 2 km from the beach, this stunning duplex apartment within Residence Oasi is the ideal choice for those looking to live in a modern, private context immersed in peace without sacrificing any amenities. The property is located in a building with only six units, ensuring privacy and an exclusive atmosphere. The large livable terrace, completely south-facing and overlooking greenery, becomes a true extension of the living area: the perfect place to have breakfast in the sun, dine outdoors or enjoy moments of relaxation surrounded by nature. The entrance leads to a bright open-plan living area with kitchen nook, dining room and lounge designed to provide welcoming and functional spaces. On the same level there’s a practical hallway used as laundry space along with a first bathroom featuring windows and shower. A staircase leads up to the attic sleeping area where you will find a spacious master bedroom, a single bedroom and another windowed bathroom with shower providing comfort and practicality for all family members. Built in 2018, this property boasts prestigious energy class A4 status; it features photovoltaic systems and underfloor heating which ensure low consumption levels while maximizing living comfort throughout every season allowing for year-round residency whether as primary accommodation or refined vacation retreat. Completing this offering are two covered parking spaces alongside very minimal condominium fees making this proposal even more appealing. A ready-to-live-in house where quality construction meets energy efficiency; well-distributed spaces bathed in light thanks to its southern exposure combined together create splendid views over green areas merging into one serene style lifestyle close enough yet far removed from seaside chaos! Contact us for further information or schedule your visit!
